about: measure contests of 2018 in West Virginia, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, 2018 precinct-level returns, GitHub MEDSL/2018-elections-official at commit 42055b11dcd5
medsl.licence: no licence file in the repository; MEDSL's Dataverse sets of the same year are CC0 1.0
medsl.note: MEDSL's own earlier release, read by git (the repository now points to its Dataverse sets, which sit behind a guestbook; pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py --compare-dataverse matches the files by MD5); added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py, files 2018-wv-precinct-general.zip

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

threshold.rule: Majority of qualified voters voting on the question
threshold.quote: If a majority of the qualified voters, voting on the question at the polls held pursuant to such law, ratify the proposed amendment, it shall be in force from the time of such ratification, as part of the constitution of the state.
threshold.matched: by the type the source's title states (amendment)

p.not_computed: fewer than 100 like measures in earlier years in the sources taken in (83) for the class 'statewide measure'
